title: Meowbox Alternatives: 5 Boxes Like Meowbox, Compared - Cratejoy
summary: Looking for a Meowbox alternative? Compare five cat subscription boxes by price and contents, from $15 toy packs to giant boxes with beds, and coffee for you.
body_markdown:
## Meowbox alternatives, compared


Closest match


### KitNipBox vs Meowbox


[Visit KitNipBox](https://www.kitnipbox.com/)


**Best for:** A Meowbox subscriber who wants the same monthly mix of toys and treats for a little less, or a home with more than one cat.


KitNipBox packs cat toys, treats, and accessories into a box each month, and its US-based team designs the toys. The Happy Cat box holds up to five items and the Multi-Cat box up to seven.


#### What feels familiar


Toys and treats for the cat every month, a no-treat option for special diets, free US shipping, and a share of each month’s proceeds going to shelters and rescues.


#### What changes


The Happy Cat box costs about $2 less than Meowbox, and the Multi-Cat box gives a house of cats more to share, a size Meowbox doesn’t sell. There’s no every-other-month plan, and you need to cancel at least a week before your next box ships.


Lowest price


### Pet Treater Cat Pack vs Meowbox


[Visit Pet Treater](https://www.pettreater.com/treatyourcat.php)


**Best for:** Keeping a monthly box of cat toys going on a smaller budget.


Pet Treater fills each monthly Cat Pack with 3 to 4 toys, treats, and accessories. Most of its treats are made in the US or Canada, and none come from China. The Multi-Cat Pack holds 5 to 8 items for $25.


#### What feels familiar


Surprise toys and treats every month. Checkout asks about peanut, chicken, and grain allergies, and a cat with more than one gets toys in place of treats.


#### What changes


Each pack holds fewer items than a Meowbox. The first shipment is a welcome pack of past favorites, and later packs go out around the 10th. You cancel by email, and packs that are already billed or shipped can’t be refunded.


Beds and scratchers


### BoxCat vs Meowbox


[Visit BoxCat](https://boxcat.com/)


**Best for:** A cat who’d rather have a new bed, tunnel, or scratcher than one more catnip toy.


BoxCat bakes its cat treats by hand and builds each box around something big. The Luxury Monthly box holds six items, including a bag of treats and one large piece such as a bed, a scratcher, a water fountain, or a blanket. The Seasonal box comes four times a year with 7 to 9 items, and you choose its large piece.


#### What feels familiar


Treats and toys you won’t find at a pet store, packed in what BoxCat calls a giant box.


#### What changes


The Luxury Monthly box costs about $17 more than a Meowbox. Each box also carries a skincare or gear item, such as a shampoo or balm, and shipping to Alaska, Hawaii, or Puerto Rico adds $15.


Coffee for you, too


### Coffee & Pet Box vs Meowbox


1st box


20% off


Preferred Seller


[COFFEE & PET Box (Brews for Rescues)](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/the-puppy-paws-pack-puppypawscoffeecompany) by Puppy Paws Coffee & Tea Company


From $39.99 / box


[Shop Now](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/the-puppy-paws-pack-puppypawscoffeecompany)


**Best for:** A cat person who wants the monthly box to bring them something, too.


Puppy Paws Coffee & Tea Company sends a 12-ounce bag of fresh-roasted coffee, a toy and a bag of treats for your pet, and a small surprise for you. Pick Cat when checkout asks about pets in the home.


#### What feels familiar


A new toy and treat for the cat every month, and a box that gives back: the seller donates 10% of every purchase to animal rescue, much as Meowbox donates cat food to shelters.


#### What changes


Your cat gets two things instead of five or more, and most of the box is coffee. Prepaid plans lower the price to as little as $39.99 a box.


A gift for a cat person


### Cat Mom Mystery Box vs Meowbox


20% off


[𝐂𝐚𝐭 𝐌𝐨𝐦 𝐌𝐲𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐲 𝐁𝐨𝐱 (10+ items for cats & their amazing moms!)](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/cat-mom-mystery-box-10-items-for-both-cats-their-moms-to-enjoy) by SinglesSwag


$59.00


Free shipping


[Shop Now](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/cat-mom-mystery-box-10-items-for-both-cats-their-moms-to-enjoy)


**Best for:** A gift for someone who loves their cat, with toys for the cat and much of the box for them.


SinglesSwag packs 10 or more surprises: toys for the cat, plus accessories and gadgets for the person it lives with. Order by the 15th to get that month’s box.


#### What feels familiar


A monthly mystery box with cat toys inside, and a gift option right on the listing.


#### What changes


Much of the box is for the human, so the cat gets less to play with than in a Meowbox. It’s also the priciest monthly box here.
